name: Remiel
source:
A senior angel who wields a bow. Rumored to be the strongest female angel.

She has a cute appearance, but her personality is problematic.

She is also an idol who captivates the inhabitants of heaven, and is affectionately nicknamed "Remi-tan" by her fans.

[Translated from [url=https://warabimochipizzacha.wixsite.com/heavensroyale]official website[/url]]
